errors.text_span: Die violette Linie („Handelspolitik“, durchgezogen, ohne Marker) liegt über weite Teile von 2016 bis 2024 nahe dem unteren Bereich der rechten Skala (nahe der Nulllinie) mit einzelnen kurzen Ausschlägen
errors.evidence: The reference description states that the purple line rises to 2000 by 2020, falls to 0 by 2021, and rises to 8000 by 2025. The machine description incorrectly states that the purple line remains near the zero line for most of the period until 2024.

The machine description does not mention the specific values of the peaks and troughs for the black and blue lines, such as the rise to 500 in 2020 and the fall to 100 by 2022, which are explicitly described in the reference.

The machine description does not explicitly state that the chart illustrates the development of indices in the areas of economic policy, financial policy, and trade policy over time, which is clearly stated in the reference.
The machine description does not mention the linear scale of the x-axis explicitly, which is stated in the reference.

errors.text_span: Die x-Achse ist eine linear skalierte Zeitachse mit Jahresangaben von 2016 bis 2024 (Tick-Beschriftungen in regelmäßigen 2‑Jahres-Abständen: 2016, 2018, 2020, 2022, 2024) und reicht visuell bis in den Zeitraum nach 2024.
errors.evidence: The x-axis does not visually extend beyond 2024; it ends at 2024 as shown in the figure.
